comment: ShellX Link v1 golden vectors. For each entry: decoding `json` must yield `message`; encoding `message` must yield JSON that is semantically equal to `json` (key order and whitespace do not matter; absent optional keys are omitted, never null). `message.case` names the message; all other `message` keys carry the field values using the JSON key names. `nonce` is a plain JSON number; 18446744073709551615 must be parsed as an unsigned 64-bit integer, never through a double. `decode_errors` entries may carry `call_id`: the call id the decoder reports with the error (absent means none). In `message`, `attach_chunk.data` and `attach_end.sha256` carry the wire strings (standard base64 with padding; 64 lowercase hex characters), which an implementation turns into bytes; `welcome.features` and `chat_send.attachments` are omitted when empty and decode to an empty list when absent.

boundary_frames.comment: Frame text = prefix + filler + suffix, filler = concatenation of text repeated count times. Size limit 65519 counts UTF-8 BYTES, not characters. Decoding must give the message in `ok` entries, and error `frame_too_large` otherwise; encoding the same `error` message must succeed / fail identically.
